Petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (Cr.P.C.) has been preferred on behalf of the petitioners for quashing of FIR No. 233/2023 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at P.S.:
Safdarjung Enclave, District South Delhi.
Issue notice.
Learned APP for the State as well as Ms. Thashmitha K.M., Advocate for respondent no. 2 appear on advance notice and accept notice.
Status report / reply be filed before the next date of hearing with an advance copy to the learned counsel for the petitioners.
Since respondent No. 2 is unavailable, list on 29.01.2024.
